headline: Brady Out
caption:
Sean Brady is reportedly hurt and out of his UFC main event vs. Gabriel Bonfim, nine days out.
Right call or bad timing? 👇

Per Laerte Viana, UFC Vegas 124 on Nov 7 now gets a new headliner: Johnny Walker vs. Waldo Cortes-Acosta at heavyweight. No new opponent was named for Bonfim.

🔥 Hot take: Walker headlining is more fun than the welterweight grind it replaced.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Right call or bad timing?
hot_take: Walker headlining is *more fun* than what it replaced.

v2.story: Brady is reportedly injured; Walker vs. Cortes-Acosta reportedly takes over the main event.
